title: Alliance leaders campaign for ‘triple-engine government’ in Anantapur Municipal elections
description: JSP district president T.C. Varun, NDA Mayoral candidate Ajesh Yadav of the BJP, 44th Division Corporator candidate Podili Babu Rao, and TDP leader Arun Chowdary engage with the local residents and assure them of the city’s overall development if the alliance Mayoral candidate is voted to power
